MEET THE ARTIST / 오칠

OHCHILL

OHCHILL (오칠) is a Seoul rock duo pairing Junhong Yun’s guitar with Seol Kim’s drums, with both members contributing vocals.

BY INDIEK / UPDATED 2026-11-12

Listen ↓Inside the lyrics ↓
SONG PAGESSomething's Wrong ↗

Also known as Jun and Snow, the pair released their debut album, Oh, Two Animals, in 2019 and their second, The Burning City, in 2023.

ALTERNATIVE ROCK / 2023

Something's Wrong

Live performance

View release on Apple Music ↗

In “Something’s Wrong”, running between buildings brings the speaker back to the same place. OHCHILL’s album notes describe people struggling to get through everyday city life, caught between feeling lost and trying to live normally.

Lyrics by Seol Kim; music by Junhong Yun; arranged by OHCHILL and HAWAGON; produced by OHCHILL.
